additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399668-DC/Si-D/MP/BE-[MP / R4 170001817]-Screen not responding CRM:01282000764
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I hope you're doing well. Since the DP cable is already routed correctly, please proceed with updating the D-Logic controller. Additionally, verify the 24V power supply to the HMI.
If the issue persists after these checks, it could indicate a hardware problem with the HMI. In that case, please plan to replace the HMI.
Thank you.
